{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:39:51.979
    | text      = For just briefly, Alex went to Ed Martin and was trying to get the Department of Justice
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:05.439
    | text      = So many reasons.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:06.479
    | text      = So Alex is on the warpath against Todd Blanch.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:17.039
    | text      = So I think Todd Blanch should be removed, not because of me, but because everybody I
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:20.600

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And then Trump gets pissed and says, do it.

    | text      = They do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:30.000
    | text      = So, Trump, you did it with Sessions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:40:32.760

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
